text: Split a tab into multiple panes, vertically and horizontally, in any arrangement, each running its own session
quote: Divide a tab up into multiple panes, each one showing a different session. You can slice vertically and horizontally and create any number of panes in any imaginable arrangement.

text: Register a system-wide hotkey that brings iTerm2 to the foreground from any other app
quote: Register a hotkey that brings iTerm2 to the foreground when you're in another application. A terminal is always a keypress away.

text: Hotkey-summoned terminal window slides in from the top or any screen edge, even over fullscreen apps
quote: System-wide hotkey summons a terminal that slides down from the top of the screen (or any edge), even over fullscreen apps.

text: Find-on-page highlights all matches immediately and supports regular expressions
quote: iTerm2 comes with a robust find-on-page feature. The UI stays out of the way. All matches are immediately highlighted. Even regular expression support is offered!

text: Global Search searches across all tabs at once
quote: Search all your tabs at once with Global Search.

text: Autocomplete pops up suggestions from any word that has appeared in the window (Cmd-;)
quote: Just type the start of any word that has ever appeared in your window and then Cmd-; will pop open a window with suggestions.

text: Copy Mode provides vim-like keyboard navigation and text selection without the mouse
quote: Copy Mode - Vim-like keyboard selection. Navigate and select text without touching the mouse.

text: Paste history lets you revisit recently copied or pasted text, optionally saved to disk
quote: Paste history lets you revisit recently copied or pasted text. You can even opt to have the history saved to disk so it will never be lost.

text: Instant Replay lets you go back in time to recover text that was erased from the terminal
quote: Instant replay lets you travel back in time to recover text that was erased from the terminal.

text: Shell integration tracks prompt location, commands entered, host, and current directory, even over ssh
quote: iTerm2 may be integrated with the unix shell so that it can keep track of your command history, current working directory, host name, and more--even over ssh.

text: Navigate between previous shell prompts with keyboard shortcuts
quote: you can easily navigate to previous shell prompts with ⇧⌘↑ and ⇧⌘↓

text: Remembers recent and most-used directories, ranked by frecency
quote: you can easily navigate to previous shell prompts with ⇧⌘↑ and ⇧⌘↓. Your most used directories will be remembered for you.

text: Shell integration enables click-to-download files via SCP and drag-and-drop uploads to remote hosts
quote: Enables click-to-download files via SCP, drag-and-drop uploads, command history per host, recent directories by "frecency," and marks at each prompt.

text: Shell integration can be turned on with a setting that loads it automatically per profile
quote: you can enable shell integration by enabling Load shell integration automatically in Settings > Profiles > General in the Command section.

text: Internet-free install option sets up shell integration by detecting your shell and modifying dotfiles
quote: Alternately, select Internet-Free Install. This runs a sequence of commands to determine your shell, install files, and modify your dotfiles

text: Triggers can provide shell integration benefits on hosts where a login script cannot be installed
quote: Installing a login script on every host you connect to is not always an option... In these cases you can get the benefits of shell integration by defining triggers.

text: Automatically switch profiles based on ssh hostname, username such as root, or current directory
quote: you can define a profile that's always used when you ssh to some hostname. Or when your username is root. Or even when you're in a particular directory.

text: Display images, including animated GIFs, inline in the terminal through a custom escape sequence and imgcat
quote: iTerm2 has a custom escape sequence to display images right in the terminal. Even animated GIFs!

text: Native tmux integration via tmux -CC shows tmux sessions as normal iTerm2 windows
quote: When you run "tmux -CC", a new tmux session is created. An iTerm2 window opens and it acts like a normal iTerm2 window. The difference is that when iTerm2 quits or the ssh session is lost, tmux keeps running.

text: Reattach with tmux -CC attach and iTerm2 windows reopen in the same state after a disconnect or quit
quote: You can return to the host you were ssh'ed into and run "tmux -CC attach" and the iTerm2 windows will reopen in the same state they were in before.

text: Two users can collaborate by attaching to the same tmux session
quote: Collaborate with another user by having two people attach to the same tmux session.

text: Splitting a pane in tmux integration mode maps to tmux split-window
quote: Split a pane: Splits the tmux window using the split-window command.

text: Python scripting API for full automation and for custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or new features
quote: Python Scripting API - Full automation and customization via Python. Create custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features.

text: AppleScript support for scripts that launch the app and open multiple sessions with profiles in new tabs or windows
quote: iTerm2 has sophisticated AppleScript support allowing one to write stand-alone scripts to launch the application and open multiple sessions with profiles into either new tabs or new windows.

text: Runs an AutoLaunch.scpt AppleScript automatically on startup if present
quote: On startup, iTerm2 looks for an AppleScript file in "~/Library/Application Support/iTerm2/Scripts/AutoLaunch.scpt". If it is found, the "AutoLaunch.scpt" script is launched and executed.

text: Generative AI features ship as an optional separate component so terminal data cannot be sent over the network by accident
quote: It exists as a separate component to ensure that there's no way to accidentally send information from the terminal over the network.

text: Built-in LLM chat can link to sessions for context-aware help, run commands on your behalf, and explain output with annotations
quote: Built-in LLM chat window that can optionally interact with terminal contents. Link sessions to get context-aware help, run commands on your behalf, or explain output with annotations.

text: Built-in web browser profiles fit into the window/tab/pane hierarchy, with copy mode, triggers, and AI chat working in them
quote: Built-in Web Browser - Browser profiles integrate web browsing into iTerm2's window/tab/pane hierarchy. Copy mode, triggers, AI chat, and other terminal features work in browser sessions.

text: Regex triggers fire actions such as highlighting, running commands, notifications, opening the password manager, setting marks, or running Python scripts
quote: Triggers - Regex patterns that fire actions when matched: highlight text, run commands, send notifications, open password manager, set marks, or invoke Python scripts.

text: Triggers can automatically respond to prompts and notify you when something important happens
quote: You can use it to highlight words, automatically respond to prompts, notify you when something important happens, and more.

text: Smart Selection quad-click selects URLs, paths, emails, and quoted strings, with right-click actions and Cmd-click to open
quote: Smart Selection - Quad-click selects semantic objects (URLs, file paths, email addresses, quoted strings). Right-click for context actions. Cmd-click to open.

text: Sessions run in long-lived server processes and reconnect where you left off after a crash or upgrade
quote: Session Restoration - Sessions run in long-lived server processes. If iTerm2 crashes or upgrades, your shells keep running. When iTerm2 restarts, it reconnects to your sessions exactly where you left off.

text: Open Quickly (Cmd-Shift-O) searches all sessions by tab title, command, hostname, directory, or badge
quote: Open Quickly - Cmd-Shift-O opens a search across all sessions by tab title, command, hostname, directory, or badge. Navigate large session collections instantly.

text: Supports 24-bit true color and 256-color modes
quote: With both 24-bit and 256-color mode, Vim explodes with photorealism: the terminal is a medley of color and code comes alive.

text: Unix-style mouse behaviors: focus follows mouse, copy on select, and middle-button paste
quote: Coming from a Unix world? You'll feel at home with focus follows mouse, copy on select, middle button paste, and keyboard shortcuts to avoid mousing.

text: Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast features keep text and cursor legible
quote: With the Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast features, you can ensure that these problems are gone for good.

text: Taggable, searchable profiles database
quote: iTerm2 provides a taggable and searchable profiles database so you can easily find the profile you're looking for.

text: Per-session configurable status bar showing git branch, CPU/memory graphs, directory, hostname, custom strings, or Python components
quote: Configurable Status Bar - Per-session status bar showing git branch, CPU/memory graphs, current directory, hostname, custom interpolated strings, or Python API components.

text: Mouse reporting lets you position the cursor and select text with the mouse in programs like Vim and Emacs
quote: You can use the mouse to position the cursor, highlight text, and perform other functions in programs like Vim and Emacs with the mouse reporting feature.

text: Notifications for activity, bells, and job completion so long jobs can run in the background
quote: You can choose to receive notifications of activity, bells, job completion, and more. Feel free to let a long job run in the background

text: Shows the last-modified timestamp of every line in the terminal
quote: You can see the last-modified time of every line in the terminal. It's useful to know how long a job took to complete

text: Internationalization support including Unicode combining marks, full-width characters, and emoji
quote: excellent internationalization support, including support for Unicode combining marks, full-width characters, Emoji, and many other Unicode features.

text: Runs on Macs with macOS 10.14 or newer as a replacement for Terminal
quote: iTerm2 is a replacement for Terminal and the successor to iTerm. It works on Macs with macOS 10.14 or newer.
